description.en:
Unleashes his demonic form for 10 seconds, gaining 30% Attack Damage, 25% increased healing and 60% Movement Speed.
The Movement Speed decays over time.
World Ender's duration is extended by 5 seconds with a takedown, up to 10 extra seconds.
Nearby minions and monsters are feared for 3 seconds on activation.

Swings his giant blade, dealing 10 (+75% AD) physical damage. This ability can be cast 2 more times, with each cast dealing 25% more damage.
Enemies hit on the sweetspot will be knocked airborne for 0.25 seconds and dealt 60% bonus damage.
Deals 65% damage to minions.
Deals 70% damage to monsters.

Sends a chain dealing 25 (+40% AD) physical damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 25% for 1.5 seconds.
If a champion or large monster remains within the impact area after 1.5 seconds, they will be dragged back to the center and take the same damage again.
Deals double damage to minions.

Passive: Aatrox gains 19% physical vamp against enemy champions, increased to 24% during World Ender.
Active: Dashes forward. This resets Aatrox's normal attack. Usable while casting other abilities.

Enhances his next attack every 24 seconds to deal bonus physical damage equal to 4% (based on level) of the target's max Health and heals himself for the same amount. Deathbringer Stance's cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds when Aatrox hits a champion or large monster with an attack or ability.
Max 50 damage against monsters.
Healing reduced to 60% against minions.

Ahri dashes forward and fires essence bolts, dealing 60 (+35% AP) magic damage to 3 nearby enemies.
This ability can be recast up to 2 more times within 12 seconds.
During Spirit Rush, if Ahri devours a champion's essence with Essence Theft, Ahri will extend Spirit Rush's recast duration up to 10 seconds, and she gains an extra charge of Spirit Rush (can store up to 3 charges).
Dash range increases while leveling up. Essence bolts attack champions first.
Launches an orb that deals 40 (+45% AP) magic damage on the way out and 40 (+45% AP) true damage on the way back.

Releases 3 fox-fires that seek nearby enemies and deal 45 (+35% AP) magic damage. Ahri gains 45% Movement Speed that decays over 1.5 seconds.
Enemies hit by multiple fox-fires take 30% damage for each fox-fire beyond the first.
Fox-fires prioritize champions hit by Charm, followed by recently attacked enemies.
Ahri blows a kiss dealing 60 (+50% AP) magic damage and charming the first enemy hit, causing them to walk towards Ahri for 1.4 seconds.

Grants a stack of Essence Theft if her ability hits a target. At 3 stacks, Ahri's next ability that hits an enemy heals her for (40/60/80/100) (+20% AP) Health.
If an enemy champion that Ahri has damaged within 3 seconds dies, she will consume their essence to heal herself for (80/120/160/200) (+35% AP) Health.

First Cast: Dashes through an enemy champion, dealing 80 (+50% bonus AD +30% AP) magic damage. Can be cast again after 2.5 seconds.
Second Cast: Dashes in target direction, dealing 70 (+30% AP) to 210 (+90% AP) magic damage based on the enemy's missing Health.
Deals max damage to enemies below 35% Health.
Throws five kunais, dealing 35 (+65% AD +60% AP) magic damage. Enemies struck at maximum range are slowed by 50% for 0.5 seconds.

Creates a smoke cloud that expands over 5.5 seconds and grants 100 maximum Energy. Akali is invisible and gains 35% Movement Speed inside the shroud.
Attacking breaks the invisibility for 0.67 seconds.

First Cast: Flips backwards as she throws a shuriken, dealing 30 (+25% AD +30% AP) magic damage and marking the first enemy hit for 3 seconds.
If no enemy is hit, the shuriken hits and marks Twilight Shroud's smoke cloud instead.
Recast: Dashes to the marked target, dealing 60 (+50% AD +80% AP) magic damage.

Dealing ability damage to a champion reveals a ring for 4 seconds.
Crossing the ring empowers Akali's next attack to deal 37 (based on level) (+60% bonus AD +65% AP) bonus magic damage.
Gains (30%/40%/50%/60%) Movement Speed while moving toward the ring.
Upon crossing the ring, she gains (30%/40%/50%/60%) Movement Speed while moving toward enemy champions for 2 seconds.

Locks onto an enemy champion, charging 5 shots over up to 3 seconds.
Re-cast: Fires the shots, dealing 25 (+15% AD) physical damage to the first enemy or structure hit, increased up to 75 (+45% AD) physical damage based on the target's missing Health.
Each shot's damage is further increased by a percentage equal to 30% of Critical Rate. Shots execute low-Health minions.

Throws a boomerang that deals 60 (+70% bonus AD) physical damage, extending the range each time it hits an enemy.
Champion hits grant Akshan 40% Movement Speed decaying over 1 second.
Deals 50% damage to minions.

Passive: Enemies that kill allied champions become Scoundrels for 40 seconds. When a Scoundrel dies within 3 seconds of being damaged by Akshan, Akshan gains 100 gold and revives the slain allies.
Active: Become camouflaged for 1.75 seconds, gaining 80% Movement Speed and Mana Regeneration equal to 2% of missing Mana when moving toward Scoundrels. Duration is infinite while Akshan is near terrain or in brush.

Fires a hook to attach and swing around terrain. While swinging, repeatedly fires at nearby enemies, each shot dealing 30 (+15% bonus AD) physical damage.
If Akshan collides with an enemy champion or terrain, the swing ends early.
Re-cast: Jumps off the rope.
Champion takedowns refresh this ability's cooldown.
Prioritizes champions recently damaged by Akshan.
On-hit effects deal 25% damage.
Each shot can Critically Strike for 70% damage.

Every three hits from attacks and abilities on the same enemy deal an additional 25 (based on level) magic damage.
Against champions, also gains a shield that absorbs 40 (+40% bonus AD) damage for 2 seconds.
Afterward, cannot gain another shield from the same champion for 12 (based on level) seconds.
If Akshan doesn't move after an attack, he fires a second shot that deals 50% AD physical damage. He can cancel this shot by moving to instead gain 20 (based on level) Movement Speed. This effect decays over 1 second.
This bonus Movement Speed is increased by 100% of bonus Attack Speed.
Holding down the attack button will fire the second shot.
Removes crowd control effects and gains 55% damage reduction for 7 seconds.
Deals 60 (+50% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and knocks them up for 1 second.

Dashes toward an enemy, dealing 50 (+60% AP) magic damage and knocking them back.
May target turrets to deal 75% damage.

Tramples the ground, dealing 10 magic damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 5 seconds, up to a max of 100 (+40% AP) magic damage.
If Trample damages an enemy champion 5 times, Alistar's next attack against champions within 5 seconds is empowered to deal an additional 40 (based on level) magic damage and stun for 1 second.
Only one stack can be gained per tick.

When Alistar takes damage, he heals himself for 27 (based on level) and nearby allied champions for 54 (based on level).
Knocking up or stunning champions with Alistar's abilities reduces the cooldown by 10 seconds.

Passive: Gains 10% Armor Pen. Her active abilities heal her for 12.5% of the damage she deals.
Damaging minions heals her for 25% of the original heal, and damaging monsters heals her for 40% of the original heal.
The empowered attacks of Drakehound's Step grant the same healing bonus.
Active: Seizes the farthest enemy champion in a line in front of her and blinks to them, suppressing the target for 1 second. During this time, she gains 10% damage reduction and is Unstoppable. Ambessa then slams the target into the ground, dealing physical damage equal to 200 plus 10% of their missing Health (10% +0.05% bonus AD +0.05% AP) and stunning them for 0.4 seconds.
If Public Execution does not hit an enemy champion, 35% of its cooldown will be refunded.

Cunning Sweep: Swings her Twin Drakehounds around herself, dealing 30 (+30% bonus AD) physical damage + 2% (+0.02% bonus AD) of the target's max Health. Damage is increased to 60 (+60% bonus AD) physical damage + 4% (+0.04% bonus AD) of the target's max Health for enemies at the edge of the strike.
If Cunning Sweep hits an enemy, after a brief delay, it transforms into Sundering Slam for 3.5 seconds.
Sundering Slam: Ruthlessly cleaves enemies in a line, dealing 70 (+90% bonus AD) physical damage + 4% (+0.04% bonus AD) of the target's max Health against the first enemy hit.
All other targets take 35 (+45% bonus AD) physical damage + 2% (+0.02% bonus AD) of their max Health.
The percent of max Health damage against monsters is capped at 55 (based on level).

description.en:
Braces herself for a showdown, gaining a shield that absorbs 50 (based on level) (+120% bonus AD) damage for 1.5 seconds and blocking all crowd control effects for 0.5 seconds. She then unleashes a shockwave, dealing 70 (+80% bonus AD) physical damage to nearby enemies.
If she braced herself from an immobilizing effect, the shockwave deals 105 (+120% bonus AD) physical damage.

Swings her Twin Drakehounds around herself, dealing 40 (+50% bonus AD) physical damage and slowing enemies hit by 99%. The slow effect decays over 1 second.
Recast: When Drakehound's Step is triggered after casting Lacerate, Ambessa will cast Lacerate again at the end of the dash.

Feint: Pushing the left joystick right after casting an ability causes Ambessa to dash a short distance in that direction.
Drakehound's Step: Ambessa's next attack within 4 seconds of triggering Feint gains 50% Attack Speed and increased range, deals 5 + 2.5 (based on level) (+25% bonus AD) bonus physical damage, and restores 50 Energy (based on level) (increases at levels 1/6/11). Stacks up to 3 times.

Deals 150 (+70% AP) magic damage to all nearby enemies and stuns them for 1.5 seconds.
Applies Cursed Touch.

Passive: Bandage Toss charges are stored every 13 seconds, up to a maximum of 2 charges.
Active: Launches a bandage that deals 60 (+70% AP) magic damage and stuns the target for 1 second, pulling himself to the target.
Toggle: Begins weeping to deal 25 magic damage + 1.2% (+0.4% AP) of their maximum Health to nearby enemies every second.

Passive: Amumu takes 1 (+4% bonus Armor +4% bonus MR) reduced physical damage.
Active: Deals 90 (+50% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 10% for 0.5 seconds.
Tantrum's cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds when Amumu is hit by an attack.
Attacks curse the target to take an additional 10% true damage from incoming magic damage for 3 seconds. Subsequent applications of Cursed Touch will refresh its duration.

Summons Tibbers, dealing 130 (+60% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies. For the next 20 seconds, Tibbers' attacks deal 70 (+20% AP) magic damage.
Tibbers Enrages (granting him 100% Movement Speed and 210% Attack Speed):
When summoned, after pouncing on an enemy, or when Annie dies.
Recast: Orders Tibbers to pounce on the target. The pounce cannot be blocked.
Upon landing, Tibbers deals 110 (+30% AP) magic damage and knocks the target Airborne.
Hurls a fireball that explodes in a small area, dealing 80 (+85% AP) magic damage. Killing an enemy refunds Disintegrate's Mana cost and halves its cooldown.
Releases a cone of fire that deals 70 (+70% AP) magic damage to all enemies within it.
Grants herself and Tibbers a shield that absorbs 50 (+40% AP) damage for 3 seconds and gains 25% Movement Speed that decays over 3 seconds.
After casting 4 abilities, Annie's next offensive ability stuns enemies hit for 1 (based on level) seconds.

Launches a crystal arrow of ice that stuns the first champion hit and deals 200 (+40% AP) magic damage to all nearby enemies. The stun lasts between 1.5 to 3.5 seconds, increasing with the distance of the arrow's flight.
Re-cast: Hold and drag to steer the arrow's flight path. The arrow can only deviate from its original launch angle by a fixed amount. Tap the cancel button to stop steering.
Ashe can still move while the arrow's flight path is being controlled, but will automatically stop steering if she is struck with cast impairing crowd control effects.

Passive: Attacks grant a Focus stack for 4 seconds. At 4 stacks, she can cast this ability.
Active: Gains 20% Attack Speed for 6 seconds. While active, her attack is transformed into a flurry of arrows, dealing 115% physical damage.

Fires 5 arrows in a cone, dealing 70 (+100% bonus AD) physical damage per arrow.
Enemies can intercept multiple arrows, but will only take damage from the first.
Volley applies a critical slow to enemy champions hit, greatly slowing them.

Fires a hawk spirit that grants vision of enemies along its path.
Re-cast: Explodes the hawk, granting vision of the area around it for 5 seconds. Units caught in the explosion are revealed for 5 seconds.

Attacks and damaging abilities slow targets hit by 20% (based on level) for 2 seconds.
Attacks deal 0% bonus damage. This damage increases by 100% of her Critical Rate and Critical Damage.
Ashe's Critical Strikes deal no extra damage, instead slowing the target by 40% (based on level), decaying over time.

Falling Star: Plucks a star from the heavens and crashes it into the earth, dealing 150 (+65% AP) magic damage and stunning enemies within range for 1 second. Gains 8 stacks of Stardust for every enemy champion hit.
Whenever Aurelion Sol collects 65 stacks of Stardust, the next Falling Star transforms into The Skies Descend.
The Skies Descend: Rains down cosmic fury on the earth, dealing 188 (+82% AP) magic damage over a larger area and knocking targets hit Airborne for 1 second. Also emits a huge shockwave at the same time, dealing 150 (+65% AP) magic damage to enemy champions and epic monsters and slowing all enemies hit by 50% for 1 second.

Breathes starfire for 3.25 seconds dealing 58 + 2.5 × level (+60% AP) magic damage per second to the first enemy hit and 50% of that damage to nearby enemies.
For every 1 second that the breath hits the same target, Aurelion Sol deals a burst of magic damage equal to 70 + 0.5 × level (+35% AP) plus 0% (3% of Stardust stacks) of the target's max Health. If the target is a champion, Aurelion Sol gains 1 stack of Stardust.
Damage dealt based on the target's max Health is capped at 100 against monsters.
Aurelion Sol can move slowly while casting this ability.
At max ability level, this ability's duration is extended infinitely.
If Aurelion Sol is interrupted within 0.25 seconds of casting this ability, it will go into a 1-second cooldown.
Deals 40% damage to monsters.

First Cast: Flies in a direction. While flying, Breath of Light has no cooldown or max channel duration, and deals 15% more damage.
Recast: Ends the flight early.
If a champion is killed within 3 seconds of taking damage from Aurelion Sol, 90% of this ability's cooldown is refunded.
Flight speed: 300 (+100% Movement Speed).
Aurelion Sol's flight speed is reduced by 50% if Breath of Light is cast while flying.

Summons a black hole, dealing 20 (+15% AP) magic damage per second and dragging enemies toward the center of the black hole for 5 seconds.
Enemies in the center die instantly when their Health falls below 5% (5 + 2.1% of Stardust stacks).
For every second an enemy champion is trapped within the black hole's range, Aurelion Sol gains 2 stacks of Stardust. When enemies are killed within the black hole's range, Aurelion Sol gains 5 stacks of Stardust for every champion or epic monster killed; 5 stacks of Stardust for every siege minion or large monster killed; and 1 stack of Stardust for every minion or small monster killed.

Casting damaging abilities against enemies grants stacks of Stardust, which empower Aurelion Sol's abilities.
Breath of Light: This ability's bursts deal bonus magic damage equal to 0% (3% of Stardust stacks) of the target's max Health.
Astral Flight: Increases max flight distance by 0% (62.5% of Stardust stacks).
Singularity: Increases the ability's impact area by 0% (40% of Stardust stacks) and execution threshold by 0% (2.1% of Stardust stacks).
Falling Star / The Skies Descend: Increases the ability's impact area by 0% (40% of Stardust stacks).

First Cast: Leaps in a direction. Upon landing, converges the realms, sending out a pulse of spirit energy that deals 150 (+50% AP) magic damage and slows enemies hit by 30% for 2 seconds. The area of convergence stays active for 2.5 seconds,
granting Aurora Realm Hopper and allowing her to jump from one edge of the area to another.
Enemies attempting to enter or leave the area are slowed by 50% for 1.5 seconds.
Recast: Ends the area of convergence effect early.

First Cast: Fires cursed energy in a direction, dealing 40 (+33% AP) magic damage to enemies and cursing them for 3.5 seconds.
Recast: Detonates the curse, dealing up to 40 (+33% AP) magic damage to enemies passed through. Enemies hit take up to 50% bonus damage based on missing Health.
Damage beyond the first hit is reduced to 20%. Deals 40% damage against minions and monsters instead.
If the curse's duration runs out, Aurora will automatically recast the ability.

Hops in a direction. Upon landing, enters the spirit realm, becoming invisible for 1 second and entering Realm Hopper.
Realm Hopper: Gains 25% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.
Scoring a takedown on an enemy champion resets this ability's cooldown.

Converges the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic that deals 80 (+65% AP) magic damage to enemies in the area and slows them by 80%, decaying over 1 second.
Aurora hops backward a short distance after casting.

Damaging an enemy 3 times with abilities or attacks exorcises them, dealing (2.5% +2% AP) of the target's max Health as magic damage.
If the enemy is a champion, it also frees a spirit that follows Aurora for 4 seconds, restoring her Health by 1–18 (based on level) (+2% AP) every second (max 4 spirits).
Hurls magical protective energy to an area, placing all units and structures within into stasis for 2.5 seconds. While in stasis, they are invulnerable, untargetable, and unable to act.

Fires an energy bolt, dealing 80 (+80% AP) magic damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 60% for 1.1 seconds.
The bolt then continues onward for a short distance. If it hits a second enemy or a wall, both enemies are stunned for 1.1 seconds; if a second enemy is struck, the bolt also deals the same damage to them.

Creates a Health shrine that grows and powers up to max efficiency after 5 seconds, granting 22.5% (+0.05% AP) Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds and restoring at least 50 (+30% AP) Health to the first allied champion to enter. The shrine restores 100 (+60% AP) Health after existing for 5 seconds.
Charge: This ability has 2 charges.
Bard can have up to 3 shrines active at once. If an enemy champion enters a shrine, it will be crushed.

Opens a one-way magical corridor through nearby terrain for 10 seconds. Both allied and enemy champions nearby can use the corridor by tapping the turret button.
Allies travel 50% faster than enemies.

Chimes: Gains bonuses from chimes he attracts and collects on the map. Automatically collects nearby chimes, gaining the following bonuses:
- 24% out-of-combat Movement Speed for 20 seconds (max 10 stacks, up to 150%)
- 400 XP
- Restores 12% max Mana
Chimes remain for 10 minutes.
Starting from 5 minutes into the game, gains 20 XP every 1 minute.
Meeps: Summons a meep that follows him around every 7 seconds (max 1 meep). Meeps empower him and grant additional effects based on the number of chimes collected:
- Consumes a meep to empower his attack, dealing 35 (+40% AP) plus 12 (for every 3 chimes he has) bonus magic damage.
- When he has 3 chimes, he slows enemies by 25% for 1 second.
- When he has 9 chimes, he strikes in an area around and behind the target.
- When he has 27 chimes, he strikes in an even larger area.
The spawn rate, slow effect, and max number of meeps following him scale with the number of chimes collected.

Passive: While Static Field is off cooldown, attacks mark enemies to deal 40 (+15% AP) magic damage after 1 second.
Active: Deals 275 (+80% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and silences them for 0.5 seconds.
Fires his right hand to deal 110 (+100% AP) magic damage and pull the target to Blitzcrank.

Gains 35% decaying Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds.
Blitzcrank may reactivate Overdrive to gain 140% decaying Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds.
When Overdrive ends, Blitzcrank is slowed by 33% for 1 second. This is increased to 99% for 1 second if Overdrive was recast.
Empowers his next attack to critically strike for 180% AD physical damage and knock up the target.
Gains a shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of max Mana for 10 seconds upon falling below 35% Health.

Releases a torrent of flame that bounces up to 5 times between enemies or himself, each bounce dealing 100 (+30% AP) magic damage.
Blaze: Pyroclasm briefly slows by 30% if the target is Ablaze.
Bounces prioritize champions close to max Blaze stacks.

Launches a fireball that deals 80 (+55% AP) magic damage to the first enemy hit.
Blaze: Sear stuns for 1.75 seconds if the target is Ablaze.

After a short delay, fire erupts at a location, dealing 70 (+55% AP) magic damage to enemies.
Blaze: Pillar of Flame deals 30% more damage to enemies that are Ablaze.

Ignites enemies near the target, dealing 60 (+45% AP) magic damage.
Blaze: Conflagration spreads farther if the target is Ablaze.

Brand's abilities set enemies Ablaze, dealing 3% of their max Health as magic damage over 4 seconds.
Stacking Ablaze 3 times on champions and large monsters causes them to detonate after 2 seconds, dealing 10% (+0.02% AP) of each nearby enemy's max Health as magic damage.
Enemies that detonate cannot stack Ablaze again within 4 seconds.

Slams the ground and opens a fissure, dealing 150 (+60% AP) magic damage and knocking up enemies for 1 second. The fissure slows enemies by 40% and lasts for 4 seconds.
After the first enemy champion hit, subsequent enemies are knocked up for 0.25 seconds.

Launches ice that deals 60 (+3% max Health) magic damage and slows the enemy hit by 70% for 2 seconds.
Applies a stack of Concussive Blows.
Leaps to an ally. On arrival, Braum and the ally gain 10 Armor (10 +10% bonus Armor) and 10 Magic Resist (10 +10% bonus Magic Resist) for 3 seconds.

Raises his shield, intercepting projectiles for 4 seconds. Braum negates the first instance of damage from whichever direction he faces and takes 35% reduced damage afterwards.
Braum gains 15% Movement Speed while his shield is raised.

Braum's attacks apply Concussive Blows for 4 seconds. Once the first stack is applied, allied attacks also stack Concussive Blows.
Upon reaching 4 stacks, the enemy is stunned for 1.25 seconds and takes 45 (based on level) magic damage.
Enemies cannot receive stacks for 8 seconds after being stunned, but take an additional 9 (based on level) magic damage from Braum's attacks.

Takes a moment to line up the perfect shot, revealing the target champion for 1.5 seconds. Then she fires, dealing 250 (+100% bonus AD) plus 20% of their missing Health as physical damage.
Other enemy champions can intercept the bullet for their ally.
Damage scales with Caitlyn's Critical Rate and Critical Damage at 30% effectiveness.

Fires a narrow piercing bullet that deals 50 (+125% AD) physical damage. Hitting an enemy expands the bullet, but reduces subsequent damage by 40%.
Always deals full damage to trapped or netted enemies.

Sets a trap that roots the first champion that steps on it for 1.5 seconds and briefly reveals them.
Targets rooted by this ability take an additional 40 (+30% bonus AD) physical damage from Headshot.
Traps last for 30 seconds, and up to 2 traps may be active at once.
Launches a net, knocking Caitlyn backwards. The net deals 70 (+80% AP) magic damage and slows by 50% for 1 second.

Every 6 attacks, Caitlyn's next attack fires a Headshot that deals 60% AD bonus physical damage. This damage scales with Critical Rate and Critical Damage at 100% effectiveness.
Attacks against trapped or netted targets fire a Headshot with double range.
Attacks while in brush build Headshot twice as fast.

Leaps to an enemy champion, dealing magic damage equal to 30 plus 15% of their current Health, knocking away other enemies and creating an inescapable zone for 2 seconds.
Hextech Ultimatum ends when Camille leaves the zone.

Empowers the next attack to deal 130% AD physical damage and grant 25% Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds.
1.6 seconds after the first attack, Precision Protocol automatically empowers another attack, dealing 40% (based on level) of its damage as true damage instead.
Cannot critically strike.

Slices in a direction, dealing 100 (+110% bonus AD) and an additional 3% of the target's maximum Health as physical damage.
Enemies hit by the outer half are slowed by 80% decaying over 2 seconds, healing Camille for 80% of the damage dealt to champions.
Deals 95% damage to monsters.

First Cast: Fires a hookshot that attaches to terrain, pulling Camille to it. If Camille misses, it is placed on a 3 second cooldown.
Second Cast: Dashes from the wall, dealing 60 (+75% bonus AD) physical damage on landing. Regardless of landing, Camille's next attack against enemy champions within 3 seconds grants 50% Attack Speed for 5 seconds. If the dash hits an enemy champion, they are stunned for 0.75 seconds, and Hookshot's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds.

Attacking an enemy champion grants a shield that absorbs 132 physical / magic damage (20% Health) for 2 seconds.
The shield type is based on the type of damage the attacked target deals.

Devours an enemy, dealing:
- 300 (+50% AP +10% of Cho'Gath's bonus Health) true damage to champions.
- 1,200 (+50% AP +10% of Cho'Gath's bonus Health) true damage to minions and monsters.
If this kills the target, Cho'Gath gains 1 stack of Feast. Stacks gained from minions and non-epic monsters are capped at 6 stacks.
Feast (per stack):
- Grants 80 max Health.
- Increases size by 6%, up to an increase of 135%.
- Increases Attack Range by 4.7 (max 75).
- Increases this ability's cast range by 2.5 (max 25).
Ruptures the ground, knocking up enemies for 1 second, dealing 80 (+100% AP) magic damage and slowing them by 60% for 1.5 seconds.
Roars, silencing enemies in an area for 1.4 seconds and dealing 80 (+70% AP) magic damage.

Cho'Gath's next 3 attacks launch spikes that:
- Deal 20 (+30% AP) magic damage plus magic damage equal to (2.3% +0.6% × Feast stacks) of the target's max Health.
- Slow by 30%, decaying over 1.5 seconds.
Vorpal Spikes' width increases with Cho'Gath's size.
Base damage against minions and monsters is capped at 100 (+30% AP).

Killing an enemy restores 16 + 2 × level Health and 4 + 0.35 × level Mana.
The values restored are doubled if the unit is a champion, turret, or epic monster.

Fires a missile that explodes on the first target hit, dealing 70 (+65% bonus AD) physical damage to nearby enemies.
Big One: Every third missile is a Big One that deals 140 (+130% bonus AD) physical damage and has a bigger area of effect and increased blast radius.
Charge: Gains a charge every 16 seconds, storing up to 4 charges. Attacks against champions reduce the time between charges by 2 (2 +200% Crit Rate) seconds on hit.
Fires a bomb, dealing 60 (+110% bonus AD +100% AP) magic damage and granting vision of the area.
Flies a short distance, leaving a burning trail for 2.5 seconds. The trail burns enemies in it for 60 (+60% bonus AD +60% AP) magic damage per second, dealing up to 150 magic damage.

Fires a gatling gun, dealing 20 (+55% bonus AD) physical damage per second, up to a total of 80 physical damage over 4 seconds. Shreds up to 12 Armor and Magic Resist for 2 seconds.
Corki automatically fires Gatling Gun at his current target.

Hextech Shrapnel: Attacks and Spellblade deal 16% bonus true damage.
The Package: After hitting enemy champions 6 times with Missile Barrage, The Package is delivered to Corki.
He can pick it up to gain 4 Big Ones.
The Package despawns after 15 seconds.

Leaps to execute a champion. Deals 125 (+75% bonus AD) true damage, increased by 20% per Hemorrhage stack, and applies Hemorrhage.
Killing the target with Noxian Guillotine refreshes its cooldown, refunds its Mana cost, grants Noxian Might for 5 seconds, and causes nearby minions and monsters to flee for 1.5 seconds.

Swings his axe after a brief delay. Enemies on the inside take light physical damage, while enemies hit by the blade of the axe take heavy physical damage. Heals himself for 15% of his missing Health for each champion or large monster hit by the blade (max 45%) and applies Hemorrhage.

Empowers his next attack within 8 seconds to deal an additional 30% AD physical damage and slows by 90% for 1 second.
Killing the target refunds 100% of the Mana cost and reduces the cooldown by 50%.

Passive: Gains 15% Armor Penetration.
Active: Pulls in enemies in front of him, slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds.

Attacks cause enemies to bleed, dealing 18 (+40% bonus AD) physical damage over 5 seconds. Can stack up to 5 times.
Upon reaching full stacks, Darius gains Noxian Might for 5 seconds, gaining 32 (based on level) Attack Damage and applying full stacks of Hemorrhage instead of 1 stack.
Deals 180% damage to monsters.

Summons the moon, illuminating an area that expands. Enemies in this area are slowed by 20%. During this time, Diana charges for up to 1 second, triggering Moonfall Glow when the charge is complete. Diana can move and cast abilities and spells while charging up.
Diana cannot cast this ability if there are no enemy champions nearby.
Moonfall Glow: Slams the moon down, marking enemies with Moonlight and dealing 100 (+40% AP)–200 (+80% AP) magic damage based on charge time. Targets are slowed by 20% for 2 seconds.
Unleashes an arcing bolt of energy that deals 60 (+70% AP) magic damage and applies Moonlight for 3 seconds.

Creates 3 moonlight spheres that orbit Diana for 5 seconds. Upon contact with enemies the spheres detonate, dealing 20 (+20% AP) magic damage.
Also grants a shield that absorbs 50 (+40% AP) damage. If the third sphere detonates, the shield is increased by 50 (+40% AP).

Dashes to a point near an enemy, dealing 40 (+30% AP) magic damage and removing Moonlight in an area.
Lunar Rush's cooldown is reduced to 0.5 seconds if it removes Moonlight from an enemy.

After casting an ability, Diana gains 30% (based on level) Attack Speed for 4 seconds.
Every third attack deals an additional 35 magic damage to nearby enemies.
Dr. Mundo restores 25% of his missing Health. He also gains Attack Damage equal to 4% bonus Health and 15% Movement Speed for 10 seconds, and heals 15% of his maximum Health over the duration.

Throws his bonesaw, dealing magic damage equal to 20% of the target's current Health (min: 90) and slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds.
Hitting an enemy heals Dr. Mundo for 25, or 50 on hitting a champion or monster.
Deals up to 250 damage against monsters.

Charges a defibrillator for 4 seconds, dealing 20 magic damage per second to nearby enemies.
Re-cast: Detonates the defibrillator, dealing 20 (+5% bonus Health) magic damage to nearby enemies. If the detonation damaged an enemy, Dr. Mundo heals for 15% of the damage taken during Heart Zapper's duration. If it damaged a champion or monster, he heals 30% instead.

Passive: Dr. Mundo gains up to 30 Attack Damage based on his missing Health.
Active: Empowers his next attack to deal an additional 5 (+5% bonus Health) physical damage, increased by up to 60% based on Dr. Mundo's missing Health.
Dr. Mundo swats the target away if it was killed or was a small monster, dealing the same damage to enemies it hits.

Resists the first immobilizing effect, losing 3% current Health instead and dropping a Chemical Canister nearby. Retrieving the Canister reduces the cooldown by 10 seconds and heals Dr. Mundo for 4% of his maximum Health (40-second cooldown). Regenerates 1% (based on level) of his maximum Health every 5 seconds. Enemy champions destroy the Canister if they reach it first.

Hurls 2 massive axes, dealing 200 (+150% bonus AD) physical damage.
The axes return to Draven when they hit a champion, upon reactivation, or when they reach the edge of the map.
Enemy champions hit whose current Health is lower than Draven's current Adoration stacks are executed.
The axes deal 5% less damage as they damage targets, minimum 50%. Upon reversal, the reduction is reset to deal full damage.

Gains a Spinning Axe, causing his next attack within 6 seconds to deal an additional 45 (+90% bonus AD) physical damage.
The Spinning Axe bounces off the target, allowing Draven to catch and regain it.
Draven can hold 2 Spinning Axes at once.

Gains 25% Attack Speed for 3 seconds and 50% Movement Speed that decays over 1.5 seconds.
Catching a Spinning Axe refreshes Blood Rush's cooldown.
Throws his axes, dealing 75 (+50% bonus AD) physical damage and knocking enemies aside, slowing them by 25% for 2 seconds.

Killing a unit or catching a Spinning Axe grants a stack of Adoration.
Killing champions consumes all Adoration stacks and grants 60 bonus gold plus 3 per stack of Adoration.
When Draven dies, half of Adoration stacks are lost.

Becomes untargetable and returns to his position 3.5 seconds ago and heals for 150 (+50% AP), increased by 3% per 1% of Health lost within 3.5 seconds.
Upon arrival, Ekko deals 200 (+150% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies.

Throws a temporal device, dealing 90 (+30% AP) magic damage. On hitting a champion or the distance limit, it expands into a field that slows by 30%. The device then returns to Ekko, dealing 70 (+60% AP) magic damage.
Deals 115% damage to monsters.

Passive: Attacks against Low Health targets deal an additional 3% (+0.025% AP) missing Health magic damage.
Active: Launches a chronosphere that lasts 1.5 seconds, slowing by 40%. If Ekko enters the sphere, it detonates, stunning for 2.25 seconds and granting Ekko a shield that absorbs 70 (+150% AP) damage for 2 seconds.
Dashes in a target direction. Ekko's next attack within 3 seconds gains 250 range and causes Ekko to blink to his target and deal an additional 60 (+40% AP) magic damage.

Every third attack or damaging ability against the same target deals an additional 30 (+80% AP) magic damage. If the target was a champion, Ekko gains 40% (based on level) Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds.
Deals 120% damage to monsters.
Cannot affect the same target for 5 seconds.

Evelynn briefly goes untargetable and decimates the area in front of her before warping backwards a long distance. Deals 150 (+75% AP) magic damage, increased to 230% against enemy champions below 35% Health.

Unleashes 2 lines of spikes, each dealing 40 (+50% AP) magic damage to all enemies struck. Can re-cast within 4 seconds.
Deals 40% damage to minions.

Curses target champion or monster for 5 seconds. Evelynn's next attack or ability will expunge the Curse and slow them by 65% for 1 second.
If the Curse lasts at least 2.5 seconds, expunging it charms the target for 1 second. If the target is a champion, shreds their Magic Resist by 20% for 4 seconds. If the target is a monster, deals an additional 300 (+60% AP) magic damage.
Casting Allure does not remove Evelynn from Demon Shade.

Whips a target with Lashers, applying on-hit effects and dealing 55 + 2% (+0.01% AP) of their max Health as magic damage. Then gains 30% Movement Speed for 2 seconds.
Entering Demon Shade enhances the next Whiplash to pull Evelynn to her target, dealing 80 + 4% (+0.015% AP) of their max Health as magic damage to all enemies in the way.

Enters Demon Shade after not attacking or casting for 4 seconds. Taking damage from enemy champions or turrets puts Demon Shade on a 1.5-second cooldown.
In Demon Shade, Evelynn regenerates 17 (+7.5% AP) Health every second when she is at or below 320 (based on level) Health.
From level 5, Demon Shade grants her Camouflage.

Fires an energy wave, dealing 300 (+100% bonus AD +100% AP) magic damage.
Deals 50% reduced damage to minions and non-epic monsters.

Fires a bolt, dealing 25 (+135% AD +30% AP) physical damage to the first enemy hit.
Hitting a target reduces Ezreal's ability cooldowns by 1.5 seconds.
Applies on-hit effects.

Fires an orb that sticks to a champion, epic monster or structure for 4 seconds.
Hitting the target with an attack or ability detonates the orb, dealing 80 (+60% bonus AD +75% AP) magic damage and refunding 60 Mana.

Blinks to target location and fires a bolt, dealing 80 (+50% bonus AD +75% AP) magic damage.
Prioritizes enemies hit by Essence Flux, then the nearest enemy.
Gains 13% Attack Speed for 8 seconds when hitting targets with abilities, stacking up to 4 times.

Channels for 1.5 seconds, then blinks to the target location and summons Crowstorm, dealing 30 (+10% AP) magic damage every 0.25 seconds to nearby enemies for 5 seconds. Crowstorm deals a maximum of 600 magic damage.

Passive: While unseen and out of combat for 2 seconds, or while impersonating an Effigy, damaging an enemy with an ability fears them for 1.2 seconds.
Active: Unleashes a murder of crows, fearing the target hit for 1.2 seconds and dealing 4% of their current Health as magic damage, increased by 1.5% per 100 AP. Deals at least 45 damage.
If the target has recently been feared, they take 200% more damage instead of becoming feared again.
Deals a maximum of 400 damage against monsters.

Channels and drains the souls of nearby enemies, dealing 60 (+30% AP) magic damage per second for 2 seconds, plus 10% of the target's missing Health as damage at the end.
Pain to Gain: Restores 40% of the damage as Health (calculated based on pre-mitigation damage).
Fiddlesticks is slowed by 30% while channeling.
Recast anytime to end the channel early. If Fiddlesticks completes the channel without interruption, this ability's remaining cooldown is reduced by 50%.
Health restored varies by target:
- Champions: 40%
- Minions: 15%
- Monsters: 45%
Deals 160% damage against monsters
and 50% damage against minions.
Slashes the target location with its scythe, dealing 70 (+50% AP) magic damage to enemies within the area and slowing them by 35% for 1.25 seconds. Enemies in the center are silenced.

After a champion takedown, summons a Scarecrow Effigy for 3 seconds. The Effigy automatically tracks the nearest enemy champion, detonating upon reaching them or when its duration ends to fear all enemy champions nearby.
Only 1 Effigy can exist at one time.

Reveals all 4 Vitals on an enemy champion for 8 seconds and gains Duelist's Dance's Movement Speed bonus while near them.
If Fiora strikes all 4 Vitals within 8 seconds, or if the target dies after she has hit at least 1, restores 80 (+60% bonus AD) Health per second to herself and nearby allied champions for 2–5 seconds, scaling with the number of Vitals hit.
Striking all 4 Vitals of a champion deals 16% of their max Health as true damage.

Lunges in a direction and stabs a nearby enemy, dealing 75 (+110% bonus AD) physical damage. Hitting the target refunds 50% of Lunge's cooldown.
Lunge prioritizes Vitals and enemies it will kill and applies on-hit effects to the main target.
Lunge deals 50% damage to monsters and can deal damage to turrets.

Parries all incoming damage and debuffs for the next 0.75 seconds. Then stabs in the target direction, dealing 120 (+100% AP) magic damage to the first enemy champion hit, slowing their Movement Speed and Attack Speed by 50% for 1.5 seconds.
Riposte stuns instead of slows if it parries an immobilizing effect.

Empowers the next 2 attacks with 60% bonus Attack Speed. The first attack applies a 30% slow for 1 second, but cannot critically strike. The second attack will always critically strike for 170% physical damage.

After 2 seconds (scales with Grand Challenge's level), reveals a Vital on a nearby enemy champion. Striking a Vital deals 4% (+0.055% bonus AD) of the target's max Health as true damage, heals Fiora for 45 (based on level) Health, and grants her (30%/40%/50%/60%) Movement Speed (scales with Grand Challenge's level) decaying over 1.75 seconds.
Reveals a new Vital after striking one or after 16.75 seconds.

Launches a fish in target direction that attaches to the first champion hit and reveals them. After 2 seconds, the fish attracts a shark that knocks up its target and knocks away enemies around them. The farther the fish travels, the larger the shark it will attract, dealing 150 (+60% AP)–300 (+120% AP) magic damage and slowing enemies hit by 40%–80% based on the size of the shark.
If the fish does not attach to a champion, it will flop on the ground and still attract a shark at its location.
Dashes through target enemy, dealing 20 (+60% AP) magic damage plus 100% AD physical damage and applying on-hit effects.

Empowers the next attack to gush water around the target, dealing 50 (+45% AP) bonus magic damage and applying Seastone Trident to enemies hit. Additional attacks within 5 seconds deal 10 (+40% AP) bonus magic damage.
Killing a unit with the first attack reduces Rending Wave's cooldown to 1 second.

Vaults to target location, becoming untargetable while balanced on the trident. After 1.2 seconds, Fizz hops down with a large splash that deals 80 (+80% AP) magic damage and slows enemies hit by 40% for 2 seconds.
Re-cast: Hop down early towards a direction, but deal damage in a smaller splash that does not slow enemies.

Attacks deal an additional 24 (based on level) (+45% AP) magic damage over 3 seconds.
Deals 100% damage to monsters.

Grants Shield of Durand's passive shield for 5 seconds to all allied champions near the target and designates the position as his landing spot.
After 2.5 seconds, Galio arrives at the location, dealing 150 (+70% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and knocking them up for 0.75 seconds.

Fires 2 windblasts that deal 70 (+75% AP) magic damage and converge into a tornado.
The tornado deals magic damage equal to 8% (+2% AP) of target's maximum Health over 1.5 seconds.

Passive: Gains a shield that absorbs magic damage equal to 8% Health for 3.5 seconds after not taking damage for 12 seconds.
Defend (Hold to charge): Enters a defensive stance for up to 2 seconds based on the charge duration. While in this state, he is slowed by 15% and takes 25% (+4% AP +8% bonus Magic Resist +1% bonus Health) reduced magic damage and 12.5% (+2% AP +4% bonus Magic Resist +0.5% bonus Health) reduced physical damage.
Taunt (Release to cast): Taunts nearby enemy champions for 0.5–1.5 seconds based on charge duration, dealing 40 (+55% AP) magic damage.

Dashes forward until he hits an enemy champion or terrain, dealing 90 (+80% AP) magic damage to enemies and knocking them up for 0.75 seconds.
Deals 85% damage to minions and monsters.

Enhances his next attack to gain 40% bonus Attack Speed and deal 15 + 10 × level (+100% AD +45% AP +60% bonus Magic Resist) magic damage to nearby enemies.
Hitting an enemy champion or epic monster with an ability reduces this ability's cooldown by 3 seconds. This effect can only be triggered once per cast.

Calls forth the might of Demacia to execute an enemy champion, dealing true damage equal to 150 plus 15% (+0.12% bonus AD) of the target's missing Health. Nearby enemies take true damage equal to 75 plus 7.5% (+0.06% bonus AD) of their missing Health.
Deals a max of 600 damage to epic monsters.

Breaks free from all slows, becoming immune to them for 0.5 seconds and gaining 35% Movement Speed for 2 seconds.
The next attack within 3 seconds is empowered to deal an additional 40 (+40% AD) physical damage and silence the target for 1.5 seconds.

Passive: Gains 10% bonus Magic Resist and Armor.
Active: Reduces incoming damage by 30% for 4 seconds. On cast, Garen gains 60% Tenacity for 1 second and a shield that absorbs 65 (+20% bonus Health) damage for 2.5 seconds. The shield starts decaying after 1 second.

First Cast: Rapidly spins his sword for 3 seconds, dealing 13 (+25% AD) physical damage up to 8 times over the duration. Every 4 champion levels, the number of spins increases by 1, up to 11 strikes.
Judgment can be recast by tapping the ability button 1 second after the first cast.
Recast: Ends Judgment early and reduces its cooldown by the duration remaining.
Armor Shred: When a champion is hit by 6 strikes, their Armor is shredded by 10% for 4.5 seconds.
Every hit refreshes the effect duration.
The target nearest to Garen takes 20% increased damage.

If Garen has not been struck by damage or enemy abilities within the last 5 seconds, he regenerates 1.2% (based on level) missing Health per second.
Damage from minions and non-epic monsters does not affect this effect.

Mini Gnar (Passive): Hyper's Movement Speed bonus is increased to 35%.
Mega Gnar: Knocks back enemies around him, dealing 200 (+50% bonus AD +100% AP) physical damage and slowing them by 45% for 1.25 seconds.
GNAR!'s damage to enemies knocked back into a wall increases by 50%, dealing 300 physical damage and stunning them instead of slowing.

Mini Gnar: Throws a boomerang that deals 5 (+125% AD) physical damage and slows enemies by 20% for 2 seconds. The boomerang returns to Gnar after hitting the target, dealing 50% damage to subsequent enemies. Each enemy can only be hit once. Catching the boomerang reduces its cooldown by 40%.
Mega Gnar: Throws a boulder, dealing 40 (+140% AD) physical damage and slowing the target hit and nearby enemies by 35% for 2 seconds. Picking up the boulder within 5 seconds reduces its cooldown by 70%.
The boomerang generates 1 Rage (increases at levels 1/5/10) when it hits a champion and 1 Rage (increases at levels 1/5/10) when it hits a non-champion. Only the first hit on each target generates Rage.

Mini Gnar (Passive): Every third attack or ability on the same enemy deals an additional 10 (+100% AP) plus 7% of the target's max Health as magic damage and grants 20% Movement Speed (based on GNAR!'s level) that decays over 3 seconds.
Mini Gnar (Active): Gains 35% Attack Speed for 6 seconds.
Mega Gnar: Smashes down on the area in front of him, dealing 45 (+100% AD) physical damage in an area and stunning for 1.25 seconds.
Gains Hyper's passive Movement Speed bonus upon leaving Mega Gnar form.
Mini Gnar (Passive) deals up to 300 damage to monsters.

Mini Gnar: Leaps to a location. If Gnar lands on a unit, he will bounce off it, traveling further in the same direction. Deals 50 (+6% of his max Health) physical damage and briefly slows the unit landed on by 80% if they are an enemy.
Mega Gnar: Leaps to a location, dealing 80 (+6% of his max Health) physical damage to nearby enemies on landing. Enemies Gnar lands directly on top of are slowed briefly by 80%.
If casting Hop transforms Gnar into Mega Gnar, Mega Gnar will also bounce off the unit he lands on and travel further.

Dealing or taking damage generates Rage. At max Rage, Gnar's abilities will change, and his next ability transforms him into Mega Gnar for 15 seconds.
Mini Gnar: Gains 0 Movement Speed (max 20) (based on level), 0 Attack Range (max 150) (based on level), and 0% Attack Speed (max 90%) (based on level).
Mega Gnar: Gains 100 base Health (max 900) (based on level), 5 base Armor (max 60) (based on level), 5 base Magic Resist (max 70) (based on level), and 8 base Attack Damage (max 50) (based on level).
When dealing or taking damage as Mini Gnar, gains (3/6/9) Rage (increases at levels 1/5/10) for the next 2 seconds. Attacking enemy champions generates (2/4/6) Rage, and attacking non-champions generates (1/2/3) Rage (increases at levels 1/5/10).
At max Rage, Gnar automatically transforms after 4 seconds if he does not use an ability.
Rage decays after 13 seconds if Gnar has not dealt or taken damage during this time.
Gnar cannot generate Rage for 15 seconds after he transforms back from Mini Gnar or Mega Gnar.
Mini Gnar and Mega Gnar share all ability cooldowns except Hyper's.

Hurls a potent cask that explodes when it lands, dealing 200 (+70% AP) magic damage and knocking enemies away from the explosion's center.
The cask has a fixed travel time.

Rolls a cask to target location that explodes upon re-casting or after 3 seconds. Enemies hit take 65 (+70% AP) magic damage and are slowed by 30% for 2 seconds.
The damage and slow amount increase over the first 1.5 seconds, by up to 150%.
While fermenting, the cask reveals the area and deals 90% damage to minions.

Reduces damage taken by 11% (+0.04% AP) for 2.5 seconds.
The next attack within 5 seconds after drinking is empowered to splash nearby enemies for bonus magic damage equal to 35 (+70% AP) plus 8% of their max Health.

Charges forward, colliding with the first enemy hit to deal 70 (+70% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies. Enemies hit are also bumped backwards, stunning them for 1 second.
Body Slam's cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds if it successfully collides with an enemy.
Will always have a minimum cooldown of 1.3 seconds.
Casting an ability restores 57 Health (8.5% max Health).

Fires an explosive shell that deals 300 (+150% bonus AD) physical damage and knocks Graves back from recoil. The shell explodes upon hitting an enemy champion or reaching the end of its range, dealing 200 (+120% bonus AD) physical damage in a cone.
Enemies damaged by the shell's initial impact do not take damage from the explosive cone.

Fires a powder round that deals 70 (+80% bonus AD) physical damage and then detonates after 1 second to deal an additional 80 (+110% bonus AD) physical damage.
Detonates in 0.25 seconds if the round hits terrain. Deals 110% damage against monsters.

Throws a canister that creates a cloud of smoke for 4 seconds. Enemies within the smoke cannot see outside of it.
Enemies caught in the initial impact take 60 (+60% AP) magic damage and are slowed by 50% for 0.5 seconds.

Dashes in a direction, reloading one shell and granting True Grit for 4 seconds. True Grit grants 13 Armor (stacks 6 times) and refreshes when damaging non-minions.
Dashing towards an enemy champion grants 2 stacks of True Grit. Each bullet hit reduces Quickdraw's cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

Graves' shotgun has some unique properties:
Double Barrel: Graves must reload when he runs out of ammo. Attack Speed reduces time between attacks dramatically, but reduces reload time only slightly.
12 Gauge: Attacks fire 4 bullets. Units hit take 72% AD (based on level) physical damage, +24% (based on level) for additional bullets. Critical strikes fire 6 bullets and increase each bullet's damage by 50%. Structures only take 75% damage.
Buckshot: Bullets cannot pass through enemy units. Non-champions struck by multiple bullets are knocked back slightly.

First Cast: Hurls a needle that deals 35 (+10% AP) magic damage, slows by 35% for 1.5 seconds, and applies Thousand Cuts to all enemies hit. Needlework can be re-cast 2 additional times.
Second Cast: Fires 3 needles, dealing a total of 105 (+30% AP) magic damage.
Third Cast: Fires 5 needles, dealing a total of 175 (+50% AP) magic damage.

Passive: Gains 1 stack per attack hit (max 4, lasts 6 seconds).
Active: Snips her scissors twice, snipping an extra time for each stack consumed. Each snip deals 14 (+6% AP) magic damage, with the final snip dealing 70 (+30% AP) magic damage instead.
The center of each strike deals true damage instead and applies Thousand Cuts.
Deals 100% damage to monsters.

Summons the Hallowed Mist for 4 seconds, making Gwen untargetable to enemies outside the zone while inside. Gwen gains 18 (+5% AP) Armor and Magic Resist inside the Mist.
The Mist will move to Gwen the first time she attempts to leave.

Dashes and enhances her attacks for 4 seconds. Enhanced attacks gain 20% Attack Speed, 10 (+18% AP) magic damage on-hit and 100 range.
The first enhanced attack to hit a champion or minion refunds 50% of this ability's cooldown.

Attacks deal bonus magic damage equal to 1% (+0.005% AP) of the target's max Health. Heals for 70% of the damage this ability deals to champions, up to 12 (based on level) (+7% AP).
Deals a max of 2 (+3% AP) magic damage against monsters.

Hecarim summons spectral riders and charges forward, dealing 150 (+100% AP) magic damage. Hecarim unleashes a shockwave at the end of the charge that fears for 0.75–1.5 seconds, increased by charge distance.

Charges his halberd for 0.75 seconds, increasing the area Hecarim deals damage to. Automatically casts when fully charged, dealing 5 (+110% AD) physical damage.
If Hecarim hits an enemy champion or a large monster with a full charge, he critically strikes them for 120% damage and gains an 18% Movement Speed bonus that decays over 3 seconds. This also empowers Hecarim's next Rampage within the next 8 seconds to deal 120% damage.
Deals 60% damage to minions.

Gains 6 Armor and Magic Resist, and deals 12 (+20% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies once every 0.5 seconds for 4 seconds. For every enemy hit, he heals for 5 (+1% bonus Health).
He also heals for 20% (+0.02% bonus AD) of the damage he deals to the targets.
Healing gained from damaging minions and monsters is reduced by 50% and capped at 90 Health.

Gains 25% Movement Speed, which increases to 55% over 4 seconds.
Hecarim dashes toward the enemy if his next attack is within 5 seconds, dealing 5 (+30% bonus AD) physical damage, knocking the target back, and then pursuing them immediately after. Enemies hit are revealed.
While Onslaught of Shadows is in effect, the remaining duration of this ability is paused.
Gains 0 Attack Speed (12% of bonus Movement Speed) (based on level).

Active: Upgrades Heimerdinger's next basic ability.
H-28Q Apex Turret: Places an upgraded turret for 10 seconds, dealing 80 (+35% AP) magic damage per shot, increased to 100 (+60% AP) magic damage at max charge.
The turret slows for 1 second on hit.
Hextech Rocket Swarm: Fires 4 waves of rockets. Each rocket deals 135 (+45% AP) magic damage to the first enemy hit.
Additional rocket hits after the first to the same champion or monster only deal 25% magic damage per hit. Once the target is hit by 5 rockets, the damage decays further. Rockets deal full damage to minions.
The rocket swarm deals a maximum of 524 (+175% AP) magic damage to each enemy champion or monster.
CH-3X Lightning Grenade: Throws a bouncing grenade that discharges 3 times, each dealing 100 (+60% AP) magic damage. The stun and slow areas are larger, and the grenade now slows enemies by 40%.
Recast: Cancels this ability.

Constructs a turret that slowly builds up charge and attacks nearby enemies.
The turret deals 5 (+25% AP) magic damage on hit. At max charge, it fires a beam that deals 25 (+55% AP) magic damage.
Heimerdinger can have up to 3 H-28G Evolution Turrets active at once.
If Heimerdinger gets too far away, his turrets will become dormant.
UPGRADE!!!: Technological enhancement upgrades this ability to H-28Q Apex Turret.
H-28G Evolution Turret Stats (based on level)
Health: 110 (based on level) (+8%–50% AP) (based on level)
Armor: 20
Magic Resist: 25
Heimerdinger's turrets take 140% reduced damage from melee champions' attacks and abilities.
Deals 40% damage to monsters.

Unleashes a barrage of 5 rockets that deal 60 (+60% AP) magic damage to the first enemy hit. Nearby turrets gain 20% charge for every rocket that hits a champion.
Additional rocket hits after the first to the same champion or monster only deal 20% magic damage. This damage is increased to 60% for minions.
UPGRADE!!!: Technological enhancement upgrades this ability to Hextech Rocket Swarm.

Hurls a grenade that deals 70 (+60% AP) magic damage in a target area and slows by 35% for 2 seconds. Enemies in the center are also stunned for 1.25 seconds.
Hitting a champion fully charges nearby turrets.
UPGRADE!!!: Technological enhancement upgrades this ability to CH-3X Lightning Grenade.
Gains 20% Movement Speed while near allied turrets and turrets deployed by Heimerdinger.

Launches a vision of pure despair that sticks to an enemy champion for 3 seconds. The vision expands over time, applying a 10% slow that stacks every 0.25 seconds to enemies and dealing 10 (+5% AP) magic damage per second.
Upon reaching its maximum size, the vision shatters, dealing 200 (+70% AP) magic damage.

Paints visions of disaster that deal large damage to enemies.
Devastating Fire:
Paints a blazing fireball that flies out in the target direction. It explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 50 (+70% AP) plus 4% of the target's max Health as magic damage to all enemies in an area.
Severing Bolt:
Paints a long-range, delayed lightning bolt at the target location, dealing 80 (+30% AP) magic damage.
If the target is immobilized or only one target is struck, they take increased damage based on their missing Health, up to 200 (+75% AP) magic damage.
Molten Fissure:
Paints a field of exploding volcanic eruptions, creating lingering lava in its path. Every eruption deals 20 (+30% AP) magic damage to enemies hit. Enemies in the lava area are dealt 20 (+30% AP) magic damage per second and slowed by 30%. Each lava pool lasts 2.5 seconds.

description.en:
Paints visions of serenity that provide utility for himself and allied champions.
Fleeting Current:
Paints a current of swift waters in a line for 4 seconds that grants 30% (+3% AP) Movement Speed to himself and allied champions.
Pool of Reflection:
Paints a protective pool at the target location that lasts 3 seconds, granting a shield that absorbs 60 (+35% AP) damage to allied champions in the area. The shield increases over 1.5 seconds, up to 108 (+71% AP) damage.
Shields granted to allied champions other than Hwei are reduced by 15%.
Stirring Lights:
Paints 3 swirling lights that circle him, causing his next 3 abilities or attacks to deal 30 (+15% AP) bonus magic damage and restore 45 Mana on hit.

Paints visions of torment that control enemies.
Grim Visage:
Launches a terrifying face that strikes the first enemy hit, fearing them for 1 second and dealing 70 (+70% AP) magic damage.
Gaze of the Abyss:
Paints an abyssal eye at the target location that grants vision, locking onto the nearest enemy champion and launching a homing missile at them.
The missile roots the first enemy hit for 1.25 seconds, dealing 70 (+70% AP) magic damage and revealing them for 2.5 seconds.
Crushing Maw:
Paints crushing jaws that deal 70 (+70% AP) magic damage to enemies hit and drag them toward the center, applying a 40% slow that decays over 1.25 seconds.

Hwei's damaging abilities against enemy champions mark them with his signature for 4 seconds.
Hitting a marked enemy with a second damaging ability consumes the mark to create an explosion underneath them that detonates after a short delay, dealing 40–285 (based on level) (+30% AP) magic damage to all enemies in range.
Each ability can only trigger this effect once per target.

Fires a storm of blades that deals 125 (+70% AP) magic damage and Marks enemy champions and large monsters for 5 seconds.
The blades explode into a wall for 3 seconds upon hitting an enemy champion. The bladewall deals 100 (+70% AP) magic damage and slows by 90% for 1 second.

Dashes through an enemy, dealing 10 (+65% AD) physical damage and healing herself for 11% AD.
Bladesurge's cooldown is refreshed if the target was Marked or dies to Bladesurge.
When aimed, Bladesurge will prioritize targets it will reset on.
Deals 150% bonus damage to minions.

Hold: Defends with her blades for up to 1.5 seconds, taking 60% (+7% AP) reduced damage.
Release: Whips the blades forward, dealing 20 (+50% AD +40% AP) physical damage, increased by up to 100% with charge time.
Cannot be interrupted.

Sends a blade to target location. May be recast within 3 seconds to send another blade.
The blades converge upon reaching their destination, dealing 80 (+80% AP) magic damage, stunning for 1 second, and Marking enemy champions and large monsters hit for 5 seconds.

Hitting enemies with abilities grants 3% (based on level) bonus Attack Speed for 6 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.
At max stacks, attacks deal an additional 25 (+30% bonus AD) magic damage on-hit to champions and minions.
Attacking enemy champions refreshes the duration.
An ability grants multiple stacks upon hitting multiple champions.
Calls forth mighty winds of salvation to knock back surrounding enemies and restore 50 (+30% AP) Health to nearby allies each second for 3 seconds.

Charges up for up to 0.75 seconds and summons a powerful whirlwind that deals 50 (+50% AP) magic damage and knocks up enemies in its path. The whirlwind always reaches its destination in 0.5 seconds.
This ability's charges are stored once every 14 seconds, up to a maximum of 2 charges.

Gains 10% Movement Speed for 2 seconds. The wind spirit automatically searches for the nearest 3 champions within range, granting Movement Speed bonuses to allies and dealing 50 (+50% AP +20% bonus Movement Speed) magic damage to enemies.

Blesses herself and the allied champion with the lowest Health with a shield that absorbs 80 (+50% AP) damage and grants 10 (+10% AP) Attack Damage while it holds. Lasts for 3 seconds.
If there is a turret within range, applies a shield to the turret as well.
Passively gains 5% Movement Speed. Nearby allied champions also gain this bonus.

Heroically leaps to an enemy champion, dealing 200 (+170% bonus AD) physical damage to nearby enemies and creating an arena of impassable terrain around them for 3.5 seconds.
Damage dealt by enemies within the arena is reduced by 12%. The effect ends once they leave the terrain or when it collapses.
Cast again to collapse the terrain.

Extends Jarvan IV's lance, dealing 80 (+130% bonus AD) physical damage and reducing the Armor of enemies hit by 10% for 3 seconds.

Unleashes a regal aura that slows nearby enemies by 30% for 2 seconds, and grants him a shield that absorbs damage equal to 100 plus 5% of his max Health for 5 seconds.

Transforms the Mercury Hammer into the Mercury Cannon, gaining new abilities and ranged attacks.

Fires a mega-rocket that gains damage and speed over the first second it travels. The rocket explodes on the first enemy champion hit, dealing 25 (+12% bonus AD)–250 (+120% bonus AD) physical damage plus 25% of their missing Health as physical damage. Nearby enemies take 80% damage.

Swaps weapons -

Fires a shock blast that deals 10 (+160% AD) physical damage to the first enemy hit, granting vision of it and slowing it by 30% for 2 seconds.

Tosses out 3 chompers that arm after a brief delay. Chompers explode on contact with enemy champions, interrupting their dashes and rooting them for 1.45 seconds. Enemies hit by the explosion take 70 (+100% AP) magic damage.

Dashes to a location near an enemy champion marked by Plasma, gaining a shield that absorbs 100 (+80% AD +100% AP) damage for 2 seconds.

Launches 6 missiles that split evenly among nearby enemies, each dealing 40 (+50% bonus AD +30% AP) physical damage. Additional hits on champions or monsters deal 25% damage.

Fires a blast that reveals the first enemy hit, adds 2 Plasma stacks, and deals 30 (+130% AD +50% AP) magic damage.

Charges up for 0.92 seconds, gaining 50% (+50% Attack Speed) Movement Speed. For 4 seconds after charging, gain 40% Attack Speed.

Deals 50% damage to epic monsters.

Tethers up to two nearby enemy champions, dealing 35 (+40% AP) magic damage and revealing them for 1.75 seconds. If targets fail to break the tether, they take 40 (+45% AP) magic damage and are rooted for 1 second.

Grants an allied champion a 60 (+65% AP) shield for 3 seconds and 30% Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds.

Blinks to target location and deals 80 (+30% AP +1.5% max Mana) magic damage to nearby enemies.

Fires an orb that deals 80 (+80% AP) magic damage and silences the first enemy hit for 1 second.

Enhances his next attack within 4 seconds to gain 250 range, deal an additional 50 (+50% AP) magic damage and restore 5% (15% vs. champions) of missing Mana.

Deals 60 (+60% AP) magic damage to enemies and slows them by 30% for 1 second.

Grants invulnerability to an allied champion for 2.5 seconds. Afterward, blades rain down around the target, dealing 150 (+85% bonus AD +60% AP) magic damage.

Controls
Tap: Automatically searches for and attacks nearby targets based on your auto-aim settings.
Drag: Drag the ability button to set the trail's starting point. After that, the ability automatically searches for and attacks nearby targets based on your auto-aim settings.
