Disrupts a target area, causing it to explode, dealing 70 (+30% AP) magic damage to enemies within and knocking them up for 0.75 seconds.
Casting this ability near Vel'Koz creates an anomaly that knocks back enemies nearby. The closer the cast is to Vel'Koz, the further the enemies are knocked back.

Hitting an enemy with an ability applies a stack of Deconstruction for 7 seconds. Enemies with 3 stacks of Deconstruction take 20 + 8 (based on level) (+45% AP) true damage.
Attacks refresh the duration of Deconstruction.

Shadow excitedly surges forward, dealing 75 (+20% AP) magic damage and marking the first enemy champion hit for 4 seconds.
Recast: Dashes to the marked champion, dealing 150 (+50% AP) magic damage on arrival.
If the marked champion dies within 6 seconds of taking damage from this ability, its cooldown is temporarily reset.

Vex launches a wave of mist that deals 60 (+65% AP) magic damage. After a delay, the wave becomes smaller and faster.
Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.

Vex gains a 50 (+70% AP) shield for 2.5 seconds and emits a shockwave that deals 65 (+30% AP) magic damage.
Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.

Vex commands Shadow to fly to a target location. Upon arriving, it deals 50 (+40% AP) magic damage and slows by 30% for 2 seconds.
Applies Gloom to enemies hit.
Enemies Feared by this ability move away from the center rather than from Vex. The size of the affected area increases the further Vex casts this from herself.

Every 22 (based on level) seconds, Vex becomes afflicted with Doom, causing her next attack to interrupt dashes and Fear enemies for 0.75 seconds.
Whenever a nearby enemy dashes or blinks, Vex marks them with Gloom for 6 seconds. Vex's next attack against a Gloomed enemy deals an additional 26 (based on level) (+25% AP) magic damage and reduces this ability's cooldown by 25%.
Non-champion targets take 40% (based on level) damage and refund 10% of this ability's cooldown.

Chases down an enemy champion, knocking them up for 1.25 seconds and dealing 150 (+140% bonus AD) physical damage.
Vi reveals her target and cannot be stopped while chasing it down. Enemies in the way are knocked aside and take 75% of the damage.

Hold: Charges up a powerful punch, slowing Movement Speed by 15% while increasing the punch's damage and dash distance.
Release: Dashes forward dealing 60 (+60% bonus AD)–120 (+120% bonus AD) physical damage and applying Denting Blows to all enemies hit. Colliding with an enemy champion stops the punch and knocks them back.
Deals 75% damage to minions and monsters.
Overcharging cancels the cast and refunds 50% of the cooldown and 50% of the Mana cost.

Passive: Hitting an enemy with an attack or ability grants a stack of Blast Shield, up to 5 stacks.
Active: Generates a shield that absorbs 60 damage for 3 seconds. Each stack consumed adds 1.5% max Health to the shield. At max stacks also grants a burst of 47% Movement Speed.
Blast Shield stacks fall off one at a time and a max of 1 stack is added per attack or ability.

Empowers Vi's next attack to deal 20 (+15% AD +70% AP) bonus physical damage to the target and enemies behind it.
Vi stores a new charge every 11 seconds and can hold 2 charges at once.

Every 3rd attack on the same enemy deals bonus physical damage equal to 4.8% (+0.03% bonus AD) of their max Health, reduces their Armor by 20%, and grants Vi 27% (based on level) Attack Speed for 4 seconds.
Deals 300 max damage vs. monsters.

Teleports to a target location nearby, dealing 120% AD physical damage to all champions in the area. This damage increases with Critical Rate and Critical Damage at 70% effectiveness.
Deals bonus physical damage equal to (14% +5% bonus AD) of the target's missing Health to the enemy champion with the lowest percentage of Health, slowing them by 99% for 0.25 seconds.
Enemies nearby them are knocked back.
Heartbreaker applies on-hit effects to the primary target and ability effects to everything else.

Passive:
Attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 3% of the target's current Health.
After damaging an enemy with an ability, Viego's first attack against them within 5 seconds strikes twice. The second strike deals physical damage equal to 15% AD (+15% AP) and heals himself for 135% of the damage dealt. This strike can critically strike, and its damage increases with Critical Damage.
Passive bonuses are kept during Possession.
Active:
Stabs forward, dealing 25 (+70% AD) physical damage. This damage increases with Critical Rate and Critical Damage at 60% effectiveness.
The on-hit bonus damage based on the target's current Health deals at least 10 damage.
This ability's cast time reduces with Attack Speed.

Charge: Gathers Black Mist and charges up for up to 3 seconds, slowing himself by 10% during this period.
Cast: Dashes forward and hurls the ball of gathered Black Mist, dealing 80 (+90% AP) magic damage to the first enemy hit and stunning them for 0.4–1.25 seconds (based on charge time).

Sends forth a specter to haunt the first terrain hit with Black Mist for 8 seconds.
While inside the Black Mist, Viego becomes camouflaged and gains 25% (+0.04% AP) Movement Speed and 35% Attack Speed.

The souls of enemy champions that die within 3 seconds of being damaged by Viego become wraiths that remain in place for 8 seconds. Viego can channel for 1 second to Possess them for 10 seconds. During Possession:
- Becomes untargetable
- Gains a free cast of Heartbreaker
- Gains 10% Movement Speed when moving toward enemy champions
- Gains access to the Possessed champion's basic abilities, attacks, and items
- Heals for 5% (5 +4% bonus AD +2% AP +5% per 100% bonus Attack Speed) of the target's max Health
Viego cannot use the Possessed champion's enchantment item actives.

Conjures an Arcane Storm at the target location for 5.5 seconds, dealing 100 (+60% AP) magic damage to enemies within the area and disrupting their channeled abilities. The storm then deals 50 (+40% AP) magic damage to enemies within it every second.
Hold and drag the ability button after cast to direct the storm to another location.
Upgrade - Howl: Arcane Storm moves faster. Champion takedowns empower the storm, extending its duration by 3.5 seconds and increasing its area of effect. The storm can be empowered up to 5 times.
The closer the storm is to Viktor, the faster it moves.

Blasts an enemy, dealing 45 (+30% AP) magic damage and gaining a shield that absorbs up to 30 (+15% AP) damage over 2.5 seconds.
The next attack within 3.5 seconds deals 20 (+100% AD +40% AP) bonus magic damage.
Upgrade - Turbocharge: This ability's shield absorbs up to 50 (+25% AP) damage, and Viktor gains 30% bonus Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds.

Deploys a gravity field for 4 seconds, slowing enemies within by 25%. After a short delay, the field applies a Gravitation stack to the target every 0.5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.
At 3 stacks, all stacks are consumed to stun the target for 1.5 seconds. The target then becomes immune to Gravitation for a short duration.
Upgrade - Slow: The first time Siphon Power, Hextech Ray, or Arcane Storm deals damage to an enemy, it slows them by an additional 20%.

Fires a chaos beam that cuts across the battlefield in a line, dealing 75 (+30% AP) magic damage to enemies in its path.
Upgrade - Blastquake: After a brief delay, an explosion follows the beam's wake, dealing 30 (+60% AP) magic damage.
Controls
Tap: Automatically attacks nearby targets based on your auto-aim settings.
Drag: Drag the ability button to set the beam's starting point. After that, the ability automatically attacks nearby targets based on your auto-aim settings.
Precise cast:
1. Drag the ability button to set the beam's starting point, and hold it until you are ready to fire.
2. To confirm, tap the checkmark on the top left, or wait for the time limit if the Manual Aim Time Limit setting is enabled. To cancel, tap the "Back" button on the top left.
3. Drag the ability button to aim the beam in the target direction. Release to cast.

Gains Hex Fragments whenever Viktor kills an enemy:
- Killing minions or normal monsters grants 3 Hex Fragments.
- Killing epic monsters, siege units, or super minions grants 5 Hex Fragments.
- Champion takedowns grant 25 Hex Fragments.
Every 100 Hex Fragments Viktor gains permanently upgrades an active ability.
When all of his basic abilities are upgraded, the Hexcore will be perfected, augmenting Arcane Storm.

Infects an area with a toxic plague that infects enemies hit for 4 seconds, after which the plague explodes, dealing 150 (+70% AP) magic damage to infected targets. Also deals 10% of the damage taken by the targets during the infection period as bonus magic damage. After 0.4 seconds, the first infected enemy champion restores 150 (+70% AP) Health to Vladimir. Every subsequent champion provides 40% healing.

Drains life from enemies, dealing 70 (+60% AP) magic damage and restoring 15 (+35% AP) Health. When this ability's cooldown ends, generates a stack of Bloodthirst.
At 2 stacks, gains 10% bonus Movement Speed (changes at champion levels 1/5/9/13) for 0.5 seconds and enters Crimson Rush for 2.5 seconds, gradually depleting all Bloodthirst stacks over this time.
Crimson Rush: While in this state, empowers the next cast of Transfusion to deal 85% bonus damage and heal himself for 30 (based on level) + 170% of missing Health (5 +0.03% AP). When cast, consumes all Bloodthirst stacks and ends Crimson Rush. The empowered version of this ability heals for 35% against minions.

Sacrifices 20% of his Health and sinks into a blood pool, becoming untargetable for 2 seconds. Also gains 27.5% bonus Movement Speed that gradually decays over 1 second. While the blood pool is active, enemies within the blood pool take 20 (+2% of max Health) magic damage every 0.5 seconds and are slowed by 40%. Also restores Health equal to 15% of the damage dealt.

Charges for up to 1.5 seconds at the cost of 2%–8% of his Health, dealing 30 (+35% AP +3% of max Health) magic damage to nearby enemies, increased by up to 100% after charging. Charging for 1 second or more consumes the max possible Health cost, but if he is below 12% of his Health, charging will not cost any Health. After charging for 1 second, he becomes slowed by 20% and also slows enemies hit by 40%.
Gains Ability Power equal to 5% of bonus Health and bonus Health equal to 150% of Ability Power (both effects do not mutually stack).

Volibear transforms and leaps, gaining 175 Health and 50 Attack Range for the next 12 seconds.
Upon landing, Volibear cracks the earth, disabling nearby towers for 3 seconds and dealing 300 (+100% AP +210% bonus AD) physical damage to them. Nearby enemies are slowed by 50%, decaying over 1 second. Enemies directly underneath Volibear suffer 300 (+100% AP +210% bonus AD) physical damage.

Volibear gains 10% Movement Speed, increased to 20% towards enemy champions for the next 4 seconds. While active, Volibear's next attack deals 15 (+100% bonus AD) physical damage and stuns the target for 1 second.
If Volibear becomes immobilized before he stuns a target, Thundering Smash's duration is paused.

Volibear mauls an enemy, dealing 5 (+100% AD +6.5% bonus Health) physical damage. If Volibear mauls a champion or large monster, he goes into a Frenzy for 8 seconds.
If this ability is used when in a Frenzy, its damage is increased to 8 (+160% AD +10.4% bonus Health) physical damage and Volibear restores 20 plus 5% of his missing Health.
This ability applies on-hit effects.
Deals 80% damage to monsters.

Volibear summons a thundercloud that fires a lightning bolt, dealing 80 (+50% AP) plus 11% of the target's max Health as magic damage and slowing by 40% for 2 seconds.
If Volibear is inside the blast zone, he gains a shield of 75% AP plus 14% of his max Health for 2.5 seconds.
Damage against non-champions is capped at 150 damage.

Volibear gains 5% (+4% AP) Attack Speed for 6 seconds whenever he deals damage with an ability or attack, stacking up to 5 times.
At 5 stacks, Volibear's claws ignite with lightning, causing his attacks to deal an additional 12–68 (based on level) (+40% AP) magic damage to the 4 enemies closest to him.

Leaps a huge distance that scales with his Movement Speed. His next attack within 2.5 seconds of landing is empowered.
If the empowered attack strikes an enemy champion, he leaps to them and suppresses them for 1 second. He attacks them 4 times over the duration, applying on-hit effects 4 times and dealing 100 (+167% bonus AD) magic damage.
Restores 100% of all damage dealt while suppressing the target as Health.

Tap: Lunges forward and bites the target enemy, dealing magic damage equal to 120% AD +85% AP plus 6% of the target's max Health and healing for 42.5% of damage dealt.
Drag: Warwick leaps behind the target and follows their movement.
Applies on-hit effects. The bonus damage is capped at 100 against monsters.
Deals 50% bonus damage to minions. Refunds 50% of the cooldown when killing a minion.

Passive: Marks enemy champions below 50% Health, gaining 40% Movement Speed towards them and gaining 60% Attack Speed against any enemy below 50% Health. These bonuses are enhanced to 150% of their value against targets below 35% Health.
Active: Briefly expands Warwick's vision, ignoring all terrain, sensing all enemies within range on the map and marking the closest enemy champion for 8 seconds. Cannot be used while in combat with champions.
Warwick can only passively sense enemies who were brought below 50% Health by allies.

First Cast:
Warwick gains 35% damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. After it ends, Warwick howls, fearing nearby enemies and causing them to flee from him for 1 second, during which they are slowed by 90%.
Recast:
Howls and ends the ability early (ending early does not shorten the damage reduction).
If recast within 1 second, Primal Howl does not fear enemies; instead, 45% of its cooldown is refunded and the damage reduction is extended by up to 1 second.

Attacks deal an additional 12 (+15% bonus AD +10% AP) magic damage on hit.
While below 50% Health, heals for 100% of the damage dealt.

Extends his staff and spins to gain 20% Movement Speed, dealing physical damage equal to 220% AD + 10% of enemies' max Health over 2 seconds. Enemies that are hit for the first time are knocked up.
Cyclone can be recast once within 8 seconds.

Passive: Enhances Golden Staff's empowering effects on attacks every 10.5 seconds, increasing bonus damage by 50%. After casting an ability, Wukong's next attack gains bonus range.
Champion takedowns reduce the cooldown of this ability's passive by 2 seconds, and getting a kill refreshes it.
Active: Empowers the next attack to deal 60 (+35% AD) bonus physical damage.
Wukong and his clone's attacks reduce Golden Staff's cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

Becomes invisible for 1 second and dashes forward, leaving behind a clone at his original position.
The clone moves in the direction of the left joystick when the ability is cast, automatically attacking nearby enemies and mimicking Wukong's Golden Staff, Nimbus Strike, and Cyclone. The clone deals 20% of Wukong's damage.
The clone takes 50% more damage and does not gain the empowering effects of Golden Staff's passive when it mimics the ability.

Moves toward a target while sending clones to 2 additional enemies nearby, dealing 70 (+80% bonus AD) physical damage to each enemy.
After hitting the targeted enemy, Wukong gains 25% Attack Speed for 4 seconds.
Gains a stack of Stone Skin whenever Wukong damages enemy champions, stacking up to 3 times. Each stack grants him 10 Armor and heals him for 0.35% of his max Health per second (based on level).
Leaps into the air, becoming untargetable and throwing out a fan of daggers which deal 150 (+100% bonus AD) physical damage and leave behind a line of Feathers. Can move while in the air.
Throws 2 daggers dealing 50 (+50% bonus AD) physical damage each and leaving 2 Feathers. Targets hit after the first take 50% damage.

Creates a storm of blades for 4 seconds that grants 40% Attack Speed and causes attacks to deal 25% more damage.
If Deadly Plumage strikes an enemy champion, Xayah gains 30% bonus Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds.
If Rakan is nearby, he will also gain the effects of this ability.

Calls back all Feathers, dealing 70 (+50% bonus AD) physical damage to enemies they pass through. The damage increases by 50% of Critical Rate and Critical Damage.
Hitting an enemy with 3 Feathers roots them for 1.25 seconds.
Minions take 50% damage from Bladecaller.

After using an ability, Xayah's next 3 attacks will hit all enemies along their path and drop Feathers she can recall. Xayah can store up to 5 Feathers at a time.
Lover's Leap - Xayah and Rakan can join each other's recall. Both will reach the Summoning Platform when the initiator's recall ends.

Passive: The last champion hit by an attack or Audacious Charge is now Challenged.
Active: Sweeps his spear, dealing physical damage equal to 75 (+100% bonus AD +80% AP) plus 15% of enemies' max Health and knocking all enemies back except the Challenged one. For the next 5 seconds, Xin Zhao blocks damage from enemies far away.
Deals 600 max damage against monsters.

Empowers the next 3 attacks to deal an additional 20 (+40% bonus AD) physical damage and reduce the cooldown of other abilities by 1 second.
The third attack knocks the target up for 0.75 seconds.

Slashes his spear, dealing 40 (+50% AD) physical damage and slowing by 50% for 1.5 seconds.
Xin Zhao then immediately thrusts his spear, dealing 40 (+75% AD) physical damage and slowing by 50% for 1.5 seconds.
The furthest enemy champion or large monster hit is Challenged for 3.5 seconds, increasing Audacious Charge's cast range at them.
Attack Speed reduces cast time.
Deals 50% damage to minions.

Dashes to an enemy, dealing 55 (+80% AP) magic damage to all nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 0.5 seconds. Xin Zhao gains 45% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.
This ability's cast range is increased against a Challenged target.
Every third attack deals an additional 22% AD physical damage and heals for 7 (+10% AD +40% AP) Health.

Blinks to an Airborne enemy champion, dealing 200 (+150% bonus AD) physical damage and holding all Airborne enemies in the area in the air for an additional 1.3 seconds. Grants maximum Flow but resets all stacks of Gathering Storm from Steel Tempest.
For the next 15 seconds, Yasuo's Critical Strikes gain 55% bonus Armor Penetration (affects only the target's bonus Armor).

Thrusts forward, dealing 20 (+105% AD) physical damage. Grants a stack of Gathering Storm if the thrust damages an enemy. At 2 stacks, Steel Tempest launches a whirlwind that knocks enemies Airborne.
If used during Sweeping Blade's dash:
Steel Tempest will strike as a circle.
Steel Tempest is treated as an attack: it can Critically Strike for 90% critical damage and applies on-hit effects to all units hit.
Cooldown and cast time are reduced by Attack Speed.
Creates a 300 unit wall that blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds.

Dashes through target enemy, dealing 70 (+20% bonus AD +60% AP) magic damage. Each cast increases the next dash's base damage by 25%, up to +75%.
Cannot be re-cast on the same enemy for 7 seconds.
If Steel Tempest is tapped during this dash, it will strike as a circle.

Resolve:
Moving builds Flow, which is tracked on Yasuo's resource bar. At max Flow, damage from a champion or monster grants a shield that absorbs 77 (based on level) damage and lasts 1 second.
Intent:
Yasuo's Critical Rate is doubled, but his Critical Strikes deal 90% critical damage.
Yasuo converts Critical Rate above 100% into bonus Attack Damage at a rate of 0.5 Attack Damage per 1% Critical Rate.
Strikes all enemies along a path for 200 (+60% AD) physical and magic damage, teleporting behind the last champion hit and knocking all enemies hit towards Yone.

Thrusts forward, dealing 30 (+100% AD) physical damage. Grants a stack of Gathering Storm if the thrust damages an enemy. At 2 stacks, Mortal Steel dashes Yone forward and launches a whirlwind that knocks enemies Airborne.
Mortal Steel is treated as an attack: it can Critically Strike for 90% critical damage and applies on-hit effects to all units hit.
Cooldown and cast time are reduced by Attack Speed.
Deals 70% damage to monsters.

Cleaves in a cone, dealing 20 plus 9% of the target's max Health as physical and magic damage.
Gains a shield that absorbs 40 (+60% bonus AD) damage.
The shield is increased by 100% on hitting a champion and by 40% for each subsequent champion hit.
Deals 60 (based on level) minimum damage against minions.
Deals 30 (based on level) maximum damage against monsters.
Cooldown and cast time are reduced by Attack Speed.

Dashes forward, entering Spirit Form and leaving his body behind for 5 seconds. During Spirit Form, Yone gains 10% Movement Speed that increases over the duration and marks champions damaged with his attacks or abilities.
When Soul Unbound ends, Yone returns to his body and marked enemies take 27.5% of the damage Yone dealt to them as true damage.
Re-cast: End Soul Unbound early.

Steel and Spirit:
Every other attack deals 50% of the attack's damage as magic damage instead.
Intent:
Yone's Critical Rate is doubled, but his Critical Strikes deal only 90% critical damage.
Yone converts Critical Rate above 100% into bonus Attack Damage at a rate of 0.5 Attack Damage per 1% Critical Rate.

Passive:
Arc of Ruin's base damage and Untouchable Shadow's dash speed scale with this ability's level.
Transcendent State (Active):
Enters a Transcendent State for 15 seconds. During this time, Yunara's basic abilities are empowered and cost no Mana.
- Cultivation of Spirit: Activates automatically for the duration.
- Arc of Judgment: Upgrades to Arc of Ruin. Its remaining cooldown reduces by 80% when Yunara enters or exits a Transcendent State.
- Kanmei's Steps: Upgrades to Untouchable Shadow. Its cooldown refreshes when Yunara enters or exits a Transcendent State.

Spirit Charge (Passive):
- Attacks deal an additional 10 magic damage (10 +20% AP).
- When not active, launching an attack grants 1 Unleash (2 Unleash when attacking champions) for 6 seconds. Attacking again refreshes Unleash's duration.
- Max Unleash: 6. If the duration is not refreshed, Yunara loses 1 Unleash every 0.5 seconds.
Spirit Unbound (Active):
On cast, consumes Unleash, gaining 25% Attack Speed for 5 seconds. Attacks are empowered during this time to:
- Deal an additional 10 (+20% AP) magic damage on-hit.
- Spread to enemies nearby the target, dealing them 30% AD physical damage.
Transcendent State: This ability automatically activates until Yunara exits the state.
If the attack Critically Strikes, its spread damage will also Critically Strike. Damage from spread attacks is increased to 250% against minions below 30% Health.

Arc of Judgment:
Lets rip a spinning prayer bead in the target direction, briefly granting vision of the area it travels through. The prayer bead slows enemies hit by 99%, lingering as it travels and resetting its remaining duration. When it reaches its endpoint, it lingers and expands for 1 second, regardless of whether it has hit an enemy.
- The initial hit deals 60 (+85% bonus AD +50% AP) magic damage and slows by 99%, decaying over 1.5 seconds.
- When lingering, the bead deals an additional 8 (+12% bonus AD +7.5% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies every 0.25 seconds.
While Yunara is in a Transcendent State, this ability is upgraded to Arc of Ruin.
Arc of Ruin (Transcendent State): Fires a laser in the target direction that deals 160 (+120% bonus AD +75% AP) magic damage and slows by 99%, decaying over 1.5 seconds.
Cast time is reduced by Attack Speed.
Arc of Judgment deals 50%–100% (based on level) damage to minions and executes low-Health minions.

name.en: ARC OF JUDGMENT | ARC OF RUIN

description.en:
Kanmei's Steps: Gains 30% Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds, increased to 45% when moving toward a visible enemy champion nearby.
While Yunara is in a Transcendent State, this ability is upgraded to Untouchable Shadow.
Untouchable Shadow (Transcendent State): Dashes in the target direction.
Critical Strikes deal an additional 8% magic damage (8% per 100 AP).

Channels for 3.5 seconds, launching 7 magical waves.
While Attached, hold and drag the ability button to steer the waves.
Against enemies (per wave):
Deals 80 (+15% AP) magic damage.
Slows by 10% for 1.25 seconds, increased by 10% per wave hit.
On allied champions (per wave):
Restores 20 (+5% AP) Health.
Excess healing is converted into a shield instead.
Best Friend Bonus:
For her Best Friend, the heal is increased to 26 (+8% AP) Health.
Wave Damage Stacks:
Waves after the first deal 20 (+5% AP) magic damage.
Yuumi can move and cast You and Me! and Zoomies while channeling.

Missile Summon:
Hold and drag the ability button to steer the missile.
Base Effect:
Deals 60 (+20% AP) magic damage.
Attached Bonus:
If the missile takes at least 1 second to get to its target, its damage increases to 100 (+35% AP) magic damage.
It also slows by 45% and reveals the target for 1 second.
Best Friend Bonus:
The missile always slows the target hit.
Hitting a champion with the missile grants the ally Yuumi is Attached to 18 (+5% AP) magic damage on-hit for 5 seconds.

Best Friend Bonus (Passive): While on her Best Friend, Yuumi gains an additional 6% (+0.01% AP) Heal and Shield Power.
Attach (Active): Dashes to an allied champion and Attaches to them. While Attached, she follows her partner's movement and is untargetable except by turrets.
Immobilizing effects on Yuumi place this ability on a 5 second cooldown.

Gains a shield that absorbs 80 (+40% AP) damage and 24% (+8% AP) Attack Speed for 3 seconds.
While the shield persists, she also gains 20% Movement Speed.
If Yuumi is Attached, this ability affects her ally instead.

Passive: When Yuumi's attacks and abilities strike champions, she heals herself for 67 (+25% AP) (based on level) Health.
If Yuumi Attaches to an allied champion within 4 seconds, they are healed for the same amount as well (12 (based on level) second cooldown).
Bonds of Friendship: While Attached, Yuumi gains Friendship with her ally whenever they kill a champion or minion. The ally with the most Friendship becomes her Best Friend.
Best Friend Bonus: Yuumi's abilities gain bonus effects while she is Attached to her Best Friend.

Zed becomes untargetable and dashes to target enemy champion, marking them with Death Mark.
After 2.8 seconds, the mark triggers, dealing physical damage equal to 100% AD plus 30% of all damage dealt to the target by Zed while the mark was active.
The dash leaves a shadow behind for 6 seconds. Zed can reactivate Death Mark to switch positions with this shadow.

Zed and his shadows throw their shurikens, each dealing 70 (+110% bonus AD) physical damage to the first enemy they hit and 49 (+77% bonus AD) physical damage to other enemies in their path.
Deals 100% damage to monsters.

Passive: Zed gains 40 Energy whenever an ability strikes the same enemy twice. Energy can only be gained once per cast ability.
Active: Zed's shadow dashes forward, remaining in place for 4.5 seconds. Reactivating Living Shadow will cause Zed to swap positions with his shadow.

Zed and his shadows slash, each dealing 65 (+70% bonus AD) physical damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 25% for 1.5 seconds. Slashes beyond the first striking the same enemy deal 50% damage and the slow becomes 50%.
Each enemy champion hit by Zed's slash reduces Living Shadow's cooldown by 2 seconds.
Deals 100% damage to monsters.
Zed's attacks against enemies below 50% Health deal bonus magic damage equal to 7% (based on level) of their max Health (10 second cooldown per unique enemy).

Discharges a nova of electricity, dealing 150 (+60% bonus AD +100% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies.
Upon hitting an enemy champion, she gains 10% Movement Speed and a 30% Attack Speed bonus that can bypass her Attack Speed cap for 5 seconds.
During this time, her attack becomes a faster triple shot that chains to nearby enemies to deal an additional 30% AD physical damage. This chain damage can Critically Strike, dealing 50% bonus damage.
Hitting an enemy champion with an ability or attack extends this ability's duration and adds 1 stack of Overcharge for 2.5 seconds. Critical Strikes add 2 additional stacks.
Each stack of Overcharge grants 0.5% Movement Speed.

Zaps target location, dealing 70 (+80% bonus AD +30% AP) magic damage to enemies in the area and applying a 14% slow effect that decays over 1.5 seconds.
If this ability kills an enemy champion, it refunds 50% of its cooldown and 100% of its Mana cost.

Zeri fires out an electric pulse that deals 60 (+100% AD +50% AP) physical damage to the first enemy hit, slowing it by 30% for 2 seconds.
If the pulse hits a wall, it expands from the point of impact, dealing the same damage and slow effect to enemies in the area. The expanded pulse always Critically Strikes champions and monsters, dealing 50% bonus damage.

Dashes a short distance and empowers the next 3 attacks within 6 seconds to pierce, dealing 20 (+10% bonus AD +20% AP) bonus magic damage to the first target hit and 85% damage to targets after the first. This damage is increased by up to 100% based on her Critical Rate.
Hitting an enemy champion with an attack or ability reduces this ability's cooldown by 0.5 seconds. Critical Strikes reduce the cooldown by 1.5 seconds instead.
Zeri vaults over any terrain she touches, greatly extending the dash distance.

Fires a burst of 6 rounds in the target direction, dealing (20/24/28/32/36) (+102%/104%/106%/108%/110% AD) physical damage to the first enemy hit.
Zeri's Attack Speed is capped at 1.5 attacks per second. 60% of Attack Speed in excess of the cap is converted into bonus Attack Damage.

Catapults the long-range Mega Inferno Bomb to the target location. The bomb explodes upon arrival, dealing 270 (+85% AP) magic damage to enemies in the blast zone.
When auto-aiming, the ability automatically selects and hurls the bomb at a target within range (based on Targeting Priority settings).
Throws a bouncing bomb that deals 70 (+65% AP) magic damage.

Flings an explosive charge that can be detonated within 4 seconds to deal 70 (+50% AP) magic damage to enemies and knock them away. Ziggs is also knocked away without taking damage.
Damages turrets and demolishes them if they are below 20% Health.

Scatters proximity mines that deal 50 (+35% AP) magic damage on contact and slow by 35% for 2 seconds.
Enemies detonating multiple mines take 40% damage from subsequent mines. Mines last 5 seconds.

All of Ziggs' abilities deal 24% damage to turrets.
Empowers Bouncing Bomb to deal an additional 20 (+15% AP) magic damage and 32% damage to turrets.
Short Fuse's cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds whenever Ziggs casts an ability.

Places a protective time rune that lasts 5 seconds on himself or an allied champion. If the rune bearer takes lethal damage during this time, they teleport back in time and become untargetable for 3 seconds before they are revived and healed for 600 (+200% AP) Health.
If the rune bearer does not trigger the rune's revival effect, 10% of Chronoshift's cooldown will be refunded.
While being revived, the target becomes untargetable and invulnerable but cannot take any actions.

Tosses a Time Bomb to a target location. The bomb sticks to the first unit it hits, displaying a small area around it. After 3 seconds, it detonates, dealing 60 (+75% AP) magic damage to the target and nearby enemies.
The bomb prioritizes champions and units that are already carrying a bomb.
Early Detonation: Placing a second bomb on the same target detonates the first bomb, stunning enemies in the blast for 1.2 seconds.
Charge: Stores up to 2 charges.

Makes time flow faster for himself, applying Fleeting Time to himself and gaining a shield that absorbs 45 (+45% AP) damage. Zilean also grants Fleeting Time and an identical shield to the nearest allied champion for 3 seconds.
Fleeting Time: Increases projectile speed by 60% and grants 25% (+6% AP) Movement Speed.
While Zilean's Fleeting Time is active, his Basic Ability Haste is increased by 80%.
Creates a time-bending force field for 2.5 seconds. While within the force field, enemy champions are slowed by 20% (+5% AP) and projectiles by 80%.

Stores time as Experience at a rate of (20/50/80) XP per 5 seconds. Zilean can grant this Experience to the nearest allied champion when he has enough to complete their next level up by tapping the minion button. Doing so gives Zilean the same amount of Experience. Experience can only be imparted to allies who can level up.
If Zilean takes damage or is crowd controlled while imparting Experience, the process will be interrupted.
Cooldown: 90 seconds
Zoe teleports to a nearby position for 1 second. Afterwards, she teleports back. Zoe can use abilities and attack, but can't move during this time.

Zoe fires a star that deals increasing damage the further it travels, dealing between 45 + 3 (+60% AP) and 112.5 + 7.5 (+150% AP) magic damage to the first enemy hit. Enemies surrounding the target take 80% damage.
Zoe can recast this ability to redirect the star.

Passive: Enemies drop spell shards when casting a Spell or using an active item. Specific minions also drop spell shards when Zoe, or a nearby ally, kills them. Zoe can pick up a shard to cast its effect once.
Passive: When Zoe casts this ability or any Spell, she gains 25% Movement Speed for 2 seconds and tosses 3 missiles at the target she attacked most recently. These missiles deal 25 (+15% AP) magic damage each.
Active: Cast the effect of a spell shard Zoe has picked up.
Spell shards last on the ground for 20 seconds.
Each missile can apply More Sparkles!

Zoe dropkicks a bubble that deals 40 (+50% AP) magic damage, lingering as a trap if it doesn't hit anything. The bubble's range is extended when flying over terrain.
After a delay, enemies touched by the bubble fall Asleep for 2 seconds. Attacks and ability hits wake them up, dealing 200% of the damage as bonus true damage, up to 40 (+50% AP).
Before the target falls Asleep, they are Drowsy, becoming increasingly slowed (up to 15%).

After using an ability, Zoe's next attack deals an additional 9–128 (based on level) (+20% AP) magic damage.
More Sparkles! deals damage instantly, and deals 50% damage to structures.

Zyra summons the fury of nature, growing a twisted thicket that deals 150 (+50% AP) magic damage at the target location. After 2 seconds, the vines snap upwards, knocking up enemies hit for 1 second.
One additional Thorn Spitter spawns for each enemy champion, large monster, or epic monster hit.
Vines spread and burst into spines, dealing 60 (+60% AP) magic damage and sprouting 1 Thorn Spitter.
Nearby Thorn Spitters become enraged, resetting their duration and gaining 35% bonus Health and 50% Attack Speed.

Zyra sends binding vines forward, rooting enemies hit for 1 second and dealing 60 (+40% AP) magic damage.
A Thorn Spitter spawns when the ability first hits an enemy champion or when it ends (large and epic monsters are also considered as champions).

A Thorn Spitter with 30 (+22% AP) Health sprouts when Grasping Roots first hits an enemy champion. If no enemy champion is hit, a Thorn Spitter will sprout when Grasping Roots ends.
Thorn Spitters automatically attack targets for 6 seconds after sprouting, dealing 10 (+10% AP) magic damage.
An additional Thorn Spitter sprouts with every enemy champion, large monster, or epic monster Deadly Spines or Stranglethorns hits.
Thorn Spitters deal an additional 23 (based on level) damage against monsters.
Thorn Spitters spawned after the first deal 50% damage against the same target.
Enemy champions' abilities deal 35% damage against Thorn Spitters.
Non-epic monsters deal 35% damage against Thorn Spitters.
